changelog:
xiaohongshu-parent-faq-stills 0.1.1

- Initial release for generating answer still packs (4–8 cards) from Xiaohongshu parent FAQ notes.
- Reads pasted public parent questions and confirmed teaching facts; lays out one answer still per question.
- Supports detailed review of user-supplied images (inspects size, aspect ratio, MIME, etc.) before upload.
- Safe, separated workflow: plans visible slot list, prompts for approval before each paid lookup or image generation.
- Executes all remote Beatra operations strictly via the bundled script, not via API or connector.
- No data invention: only uses inputs from real, visible content; does not generate usernames, likes, or answers.
summary: Turn Xiaohongshu parent FAQ notes into a 4 to 8 still answer set. This parent FAQ still studio reads public parent notes and questions, then lays out an answer still pack from confirmed teaching facts. Use it for parent FAQ graphics, answer stills, a Xiaohongshu parent FAQ still, and an answer card set.
